Privacy policy

This policy explains what personal data Acme Payments processes, on what legal basis, and for how long we keep it. It applies to our website, our dashboard and our API. We update it when our processing changes and we date every revision at the bottom of this page.

We process payout data on behalf of our customers as a processor under the GDPR. Cookies on this website are limited to a session cookie and an anonymous analytics identifier that expires after thirty days.
